{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_age_data = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of customers who provided their age
mean_age = valid_age_data['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean age of customers with known age: {mean_age}")

# Return the value for submission
mean_age"}
